The protagonist shocks the crowd[n]by racing through a casino, making[n]a mockery of the chaos below.
After ripping off the mask of the[n]security-guard-turned-Shadow, it[n]bares its true self and attacks!
As the protagonist is surrounded[n]by Shadows, a young woman in[n]a mask appears before him...
As the protagonist attempts to[n]make his great escape, he is[n]ambushed and arrested.
After his arrest, the protagonist is[n]informed of the charges against[n]him with a brutal beating.
The protagonist recalls his past on[n]the train to Shibuya, where he[n]experiences something bizarre.
The protagonist wakes up to find[n]himself in a jail cell and meets Igor,[n]a creepy-looking old man.
Igor predicts the protagonist's ruin[n]and questions his resolve in taking[n]on the distortions of the world.
A prosecutor discusses the chain[n]of inexplicable incidents, and is[n]visited by a certain young man.
By a storefront, the protagonist[n]meets a blue-eyed beauty taking[n]shelter from the rain.
On their way to school, Ryuji and[n]the protagonist wind up in a place[n]that looks like a castle.
As the protagonist feels helpless to[n]aid Ryuji, a blue butterfly appears[n]with a cryptic voice...
The protagonist finds his[n]convictions, thus forming a[n]contract and summoning Arsène.
The party flees Kamoshida, but as[n]more Shadows attack, Morgana[n]summons his own Persona.
The party uses the Metaverse[n]Navigator to venture back into[n]the old castle.
With his friend is danger, Ryuji[n]forms a contract with his inner[n]voice and summons Captain Kidd.
A volleyball rally between[n]students and faculty goes wrong.
Ann confesses to being abused by[n]Kamoshida in exchange for her[n]friend's position on the team.
Having reached her limit, Ann[n]forms a contract with her inner[n]voice and summons Carmen.
As Kamoshida admits defeat, Ann[n]comes to an important decision.
The Phantom Thieves scramble to[n]escape the old castle as it begins[n]to fall apart.
Ann says she feels like she's being[n]watched. The three hatch a plan to[n]catch the perpetrator.
Yusuke realizes the truth about[n]Madarame. With keen eyes, he[n]forms a contract with Goemon.
With his true nature exposed,[n]Madarame lashes out against[n]the Phantom Thieves.
Deciding to part with her false self,[n]Makoto forms a contract with her[n]inner voice and summons Johanna.
With his true nature exposed,[n]Kaneshiro lashes out against[n]the Phantom Thieves.
The party is on their way to the[n]fireworks festival when the event is[n]suddenly canceled due to rain.
As the Phantom Thieves cross[n]the desert in the Morgana Car,[n]they see something...
The party is attacked by the[n]likeness of Futaba's mother, born[n]from her distorted cognition.
After finding the truth within her[n]illusions, Futaba forms a contract[n]with Necronomicon.
Ann's quick thinking saves the day[n]as the Phantom Thieves escape[n]the imploding Palace.
As the end of summer break[n]approaches, the party decides to[n]hit the beach.
The protagonist and friends are[n]excited to be in Hawaii for their[n]school trip.
The principal decides to head to[n]the police station, but things take[n]a strange turn on the way there...
The party wanders into a[n]mysterious Palace that seems to[n]have appeared out of nowhere.
Angered by the Shadow's words,[n]Kasumi forms a contract and[n]summons Cendrillon.
As Haru decides to part ways with[n]her father, her true awakening[n]reveals unseen powers.
Okumura is cornered by the[n]Phantom Thieves. The showdown[n]begins...
Okumura has a change of heart,[n]but something goes wrong during[n]his press conference...
Kasumi awes onlookers with her[n]dance at the post-festival party.
The Phantom Thieves break into[n]Niijima's Palace to find a glitzy casino.
Makoto, troubled by the upcoming[n]battle, summons the courage to[n]face her sister.
Having already killed a police[n]officer on duty, Akechi points his[n]gun at the protagonist...
Akechi makes the protagonist's[n]death look like a suicide before[n]fleeing the scene.
News of the protagonist's suicide[n]casts a dark cloud over the party.[n]But then...
The protagonist appeared to be[n]dead... but such deception was[n]the plan all along.
The Phantom Thieves are at a loss[n]for words upon seeing Shido's[n]Palace.
Akechi reveals his true self[n]and goes berserk against the[n]Phantom Thieves.
The Phantom Thieves pull off their[n]greatest stunt yet by delivering a[n]calling card to Shido.
The fateful battle between Shido[n]and the Phantom Thieves is about[n]to begin...
As the cruise ship sinks, Ryuji[n]risks his life securing a lifeboat[n]for the team.
Through the power of the Holy[n]Grail, Mementos begins to merge[n]into the real world...
As the real world and Mementos[n]merge, the Phantom Thieves fade[n]from the public's cognition.
The Twin Wardens, overcoming the[n]malevolent will that split them,[n]are fused back together...
The Holy Grail, beaten down by[n]the Phantom Thieves, breaks free[n]to reveal its true form...
When Mishima cheers for the[n]Phantom Thieves, everyone[n]around him begins to join in.
Support for the Phantom Thieves[n]continues to spread...
The voices of those who believe[n]in the Phantom Thieves become[n]a force of their own.
With the prayers of the masses,[n]Arsène evolves into Satanael.
Satanael fires his Sinful Shell,[n]piercing Yaldabaoth.
The distortions in reality fade,[n]and the world begins to return[n]to the way it once was.
Over the new-year crowds of[n]Shibuya, the team resolves to[n]rescue the protagonist.
The protagonist is found innocent[n]and released from juvenile hall,[n]where Sojiro comes to pick him up.
The protagonist returns, to the[n]relief of his teammates.
The Phantom Thieves set off for[n]new horizons.
While walking through Shibuya,[n]the protagonist encounters[n]something unusual.
While visiting the shrine with[n]Kasumi for the new year, the[n]protagonist runs into his friends.
The truth is revealed as the[n]tragedy of Kasumi and Sumire[n]comes to light.
The protagonist rejects Maruki's[n]proposal for a flawless reality.
Sumire, blinded by her desire for[n]a better reality, is empowered[n]by Maruki.
Parting with her own weakness,[n]Sumire has a true awakening and[n]summons Cendrillon once more.
The Phantom Thieves flee Maruki's[n]collapsing Palace in the Morgana Car.
To satisfy his own concept of[n]happiness, Maruki evolves his[n]own Persona.
Cornered by the Phantom[n]Thieves, Maruki merges with his[n]Persona and grows even stronger.
As his allies stave off Maruki's[n]attack, the protagonist fires the[n]final shot.
Morgana becomes a helicopter[n]and the team hitches a ride as[n]they attempt to escape...
As Maruki accepts his own death,[n]the protagonist extends his hand.
With their own paths chosen, the[n]protagonist and his friends take[n]their next steps into the future.
As he departs, the protagonist[n]reflects on his life.
With a promise in his heart, the[n]protagonist sets off on a new path.
